## Overview
This document outlines the cancellation policies for all travel products: flights, hotels, and car rentals.

## 1. Flight Cancellation Policy

### Cancellation Windows & Fees
| Timeframe                        | Fee        |
|----------------------------------|------------|
| More than 48 hours before departure | $0 (Free) |

---

| Timeframe                          | Fee        |
|------------------------------------|------------|

### Refund Rules

### Additional Rules
- Cancellation is **not allowed** if the rental status is already "cancelled".
